title: Finite L¹ nets on every compact subset give an L¹_loc-convergent subsequence (step A2, diagonal extraction)
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝⁿ and every sequence u_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) of functions locally integrable on U such that for every compact Q ⊆ U and every ε > 0 there is a finite set F ⊆ ℕ with: every k has some j ∈ F with ∫⁻_Q ‖u_k(x) − u_j(x)‖ₑ dx < ofReal ε, there exist a strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ and v : ℝⁿ → ℝ such that v is locally integrable on U and u_{ψ(k)} → v in L¹_loc(U), i.e. ∫⁻_K ‖u_{ψ(k)} − v‖ₑ → 0 for every compact K ⊆ U (SimonGMT Chapter02.TendstoLocallyInL1On (fun k ↦ u (ψ k)) v U atTop).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ k, LocallyIntegrableOn (u k) U volume) → (∀ Q : Set (Rn n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ U → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ F : Finset ℕ, ∀ k, ∃ j ∈ F, (∫⁻ x in Q, ‖u k x - u j x‖ₑ) < ENNReal.ofReal ε) → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (v : Rn n → ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ LocallyIntegrableOn v U volume ∧ Chapter02.TendstoLocallyInL1On (fun k ↦ u (ψ k)) v U atTop
